items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Bill and I had a perfect understanding of why we had to go to the new world.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. As a matter of fact, almost everything that -- as far as anything that came from the trumpet section was pretty much guided by where he wanted to go.
I think Jake has Javis mentioned that he would always have his ears with what Bill was doing, and vice versa, and they seemed to work as a very good team.
